layout.name: Status bar
layout.description: iOS status bar. Left: time '09:37' in white bold, followed by a small muted bell-with-slash (silent/DND) icon. Right: cellular signal bars (2 of 4 filled), wifi icon, battery glyph showing '39' inside the battery outline. Dark background ~#14181C.

layout.name: Top navigation bar
layout.description: Header row. Left: white chevron-left back arrow ('<'). Centered title 'TREND VIEW' in white, uppercase, letter-spaced, semibold ~17px. No right-side element.
layout.interaction: Back arrow taps back to the previous (metric overview) screen.

layout.name: Metric selector dropdown
layout.description: Full-width rounded pill/card, slightly lighter grey ~#3A4047. Left: a heart outline with a small down-arrow icon (RHR glyph, muted white). Label 'RESTING HEART RATE' in white uppercase bold ~18px, left-aligned after icon. Far right: a white downward chevron indicating a dropdown.
layout.interaction: Tapping opens a dropdown to switch the displayed metric (e.g. HRV, RHR, etc.).

layout.name: Average value block
layout.description: Left-aligned. Small grey uppercase label 'AVERAGE' (~#8A9098, letter-spaced). Below it, very large white bold number '56' (~64px) with smaller white 'bpm' unit baseline-aligned to its right. No trend arrow or baseline comparison shown here.

layout.name: Time-range segmented control
layout.description: Rounded segmented toggle on the right side, dark track ~#22272C with three segments: 'W', 'M', '6M'. The middle 'M' segment is selected (highlighted lighter grey ~#4A5057 with white bold text); 'W' and '6M' are muted grey text. Uppercase bold.
layout.interaction: Tapping W / M / 6M switches the chart aggregation window (week / month / 6 months).

layout.name: Date range stepper
layout.description: Below the segmented control, centered/right area. Left muted grey chevron-left ('<'), centered white text 'JUN 1 - JUN 30, 26' (uppercase, semibold), right muted grey chevron-right ('>'). Right chevron appears slightly dimmer (current period).
layout.interaction: Left/right chevrons step to the previous/next month period; chart and average update.

layout.name: Explanatory paragraph
layout.description: Full-width white body text, ~17px regular, left-aligned, three lines: 'Your average RHR this month is 56. Wear your WHOOP to bed each night to track your sleep and monitor your RHR over time.'
literals: Your average RHR this month is 56. Wear your WHOOP to bed each night to track your sleep and monitor your RHR over time.

layout.name: Typical range legend
layout.description: Right-aligned legend above the chart: a small grey filled square swatch followed by 'TYPICAL RANGE' in muted grey uppercase letter-spaced bold ~13px.

layout.name: RHR trend line chart
layout.description: Line chart of resting heart rate over the month. Y-axis (left) labeled with grey numbers top-to-bottom: 81, 67, 53, 39 (faint horizontal gridlines at each). A shaded horizontal band (the TYPICAL RANGE) spans roughly from y=53 up to ~y=60 across the full width, filled translucent grey ~#2A3036. The plotted series is a light blue (#5AA9E6) line; only the right ~40% of the chart has data (line begins mid-chart around Jun 19), with sharp zig-zag peaks reaching up to ~67 and dips down to ~53; a tall final peak near Jun 28 (~67) then drops to the last point. The final/most-recent data point is marked with a hollow blue circle and an on-point value annotation '50' in white bold just above-left of the marker. X-axis labels (grey, two-line) evenly spaced: 'Jun 2', 'Jun 9', 'Jun 16', 'Jun 23', 'Jun 30'.
layout.interaction: Scrubbing/tapping a point selects that day and shows its value annotation (selected point currently the last point '50').

layout.name: Learn More header row
layout.description: Row with left muted-grey uppercase 'LEARN MORE' (~#8A9098, letter-spaced bold) and right white 'VIEW ALL' uppercase bold followed by a white right-arrow icon '->'.
layout.interaction: 'VIEW ALL' navigates to the full library of RHR learn-more content.

layout.name: Learn More content carousel
layout.description: Horizontally scrollable row of media cards. Card 1 (VIDEO): photo of a smiling woman in a white sweater; top-right black 'VIDEO' tag (white text); overlaid top-left a mini WHOOP RHR badge showing heart icon, '56 bpm' white bold and a small green pill '52 - 58'; a circular white play button overlays the lower-left; caption below 'What is RHR?' in white. Card 2 (ARTICLE): dark card with scattered white heart-outline icons and one green heart-with-down-arrow; top-right black 'ARTICLE' tag; caption 'RHR: What's Normal and How to Improve It' white. Card 3 (partially visible, ARTICLE/photo of a smiling person): caption begins 'What is a G... Resting He... Age and G...' (truncated 'What is a Good Resting Heart Rate by Age and Gender' implied).
literals: RHR: What's Normal and How to Improve It
layout.interaction: Tapping a card opens that video/article; the row scrolls horizontally.

layout.name: 'What is Resting Heart Rate?' info card
layout.description: Large rounded dark card ~#1C2126. Heading 'What is Resting Heart Rate?' in white bold ~26px. Body in muted light-grey ~#C0C5CB, regular ~17px, three paragraphs: Para1 'Resting heart rate (RHR) is the average number of times your heart beats per minute while in a complete state of rest. It is measured towards the end of your sleep cycle when your body is in its most restful state, Slow Wave Sleep.' Para2 'In general, a lower RHR indicates better fitness. A low resting heart rate is an indication of a strong heart muscle that can pump more blood with every beat, so it doesn't have to beat as frequently.' Para3 'Short-term increases in RHR can signal fatigue or illness, while long-term decreases indicate improved cardiovascular health.'
literals: Resting heart rate (RHR) is the average number of times your heart beats per minute while in a complete state of rest. It is measured towards the end of your sleep cycle when your body is in its most restful state, Slow Wave Sleep.

In general, a lower RHR indicates better fitness. A low resting heart rate is an indication of a strong heart muscle that can pump more blood with every beat, so it doesn't have to beat as frequently.
Short-term increases in RHR can signal fatigue or illness, while long-term decreases indicate improved cardiovascular health.

charts.name: RHR monthly trend
charts.xAxis: Days of month, labeled Jun 2 / Jun 9 / Jun 16 / Jun 23 / Jun 30 (weekly ticks across Jun 1–Jun 30, 26)
charts.yAxis: Resting heart rate (bpm), single left axis, gridlines/labels at 39, 53, 67, 81
charts.series: One series: daily RHR as a light-blue (#5AA9E6) zig-zag line; data only present from ~Jun 19 onward. Last point marked with hollow blue circle.
charts.notes: Shaded translucent-grey horizontal band = TYPICAL RANGE (~53 to ~60 bpm). On-point annotation '50' (white bold) on the final/selected most-recent point. Range high peaks ~67, low ~50. No dual axis.

excluded: Floating WHOOP Coach / AI assistant button: a circular gradient (blue/purple) button with the WHOOP 'W' logo, fixed bottom-right corner over both scroll positions — this is the AI coach entry point and is excluded from the build.
globalNotes: Two screenshots are vertical scroll positions of one 'TREND VIEW' screen for the Resting Heart Rate metric. The header ('TREND VIEW' + back arrow) is sticky/persistent across both. Image 1 covers top → the RHR line chart and the start of the LEARN MORE carousel; image 2 overlaps at LEARN MORE and continues to the 'What is Resting Heart Rate?' info card and bottom padding. Overall dark theme (~#14181C background). The floating circular WHOOP-logo AI-coach button is pinned bottom-right in both (excluded). The LEARN MORE carousel and the info card appear in both images — merge, do not double-count.
